title: Review a request
question: Compare three ways to check selected work and confirm the exact actions. Expand a sketch to try its sample flow; these demos do not change your real gallery or schedule.

options.label: Selection + plan
options.thesis: See selected artwork beside a clear list of intended actions.
options.viewport: Selection and follow-up edits on the left; renamed copies and dated X posts on the right.
options.risk: Attention is split between the selected work and its plan.

options.label: Select, then confirm
options.thesis: Finish the selection first, then review the actions in a focused second step.
options.viewport: A generous artwork selection view leads to a separate preview of every copy and scheduled post.
options.risk: The extra step takes longer for a small request.

options.label: Action ledger
options.thesis: Each work sits on one row with its new name and scheduled destination.
options.viewport: A single table connects each selected item to the exact actions proposed for it.
options.risk: Dense rows can be harder to scan for a large collection.
